GetDrawInfoBnk1.name: Get sprite draw info and off-screen flags
summary: Computes whether the sprite is off screen: [$15A0] horizontal, [$186C] bits 0-1 vertical, [$15C4] far off screen horizontally.
If far off screen, drops its return address so the caller returns to its own caller (skipping the draw routine).
Parameters: X: sprite index.
Returns: Y: OAM index of the sprite; $00: X relative to screen; $01: Y relative to screen.
$01A3DF (separate routine): hides OAM tiles 1/2 by setting X bit 8 when [$186C] bits are set.

s01A40B.name: Table: Y hitbox offsets for sprite interaction

SubSprSprInteract.name: Sprite-to-sprite interaction loop
summary: Called via JSL $018032. Tests sprite A (X on entry) against every lower slot B, every other frame, and dispatches on both statuses.
Outcomes: turn both around, a kicked/carried sprite kills the other, or both die. Statuses: 8 normal, 9 stunned, 10 kicked, 11 carried.
Parameters: X: sprite A index. Uses $1695 = sprite B, $00-$03 as scratch. Returns with X = sprite A.
Outcome code at $01A5C4: kicked/carried sprite B kills A (hedged: roles of X/Y swap inside $01A77C).

s01A625.name: Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce
summary: $01A625: kicked A hits normal B (B killed, unless Flying Question Block, which bounces).
$01A642: kicked A hits stunned B (killed if B on ground, else both die).
$01A64A: kill B: counts A's chain in $1626, plays sound, gives points, sets status 2, knocks B away.
$01A685: both sprites die (or flying blocks bounce): Y speed $D0, 1000 points?, pushed apart.

s01A6D9.name: Shell-less Koopa walks into shell
summary: If X kicks/hops into shells (tweaker $1656 bit 6), both are on the ground, facing and not within 8 pixels:
Blue Shell-less Koopa starts a kick animation; other sprites go to HopIntoShell.
Parameters: X: sprite, Y: other sprite.

PlayKickSfx.name: Play kick sound
summary: Sound effect $1DF9 = 3 (kick). Its RTS is shared with the early-out branches of the previous routine.

HopIntoShell.name: Hop into or flip shell
summary: Y = shell sprite (number < $0F), X = Koopa. If the shell is upside down it is flipped back up; otherwise the Koopa hops up
and the pair are linked via $1594.

s01A778.name: Table: shell spawn offsets by direction

s01A77C.name: Shell-less Koopa catches shell
summary: Special case for sprite 2 (Blue Shell-less Koopa): when hit by a shell facing the opposite way, places the shell at its side
and skips the kill code by dropping its return address. Falls into the encoded STZ at Instr01A799.

Instr01A799.name: STZ $163E,X then position shell
summary: The first three bytes are an STZ.W $163E,X written as data. Then the shell is moved next to the Koopa and linked with $160E/$1534.

SpriteToSpawn.name: Table: sprite to spawn by index

MarioSprInteract.name: Long wrapper: Mario-sprite interaction
summary: Sets data bank to $01 and calls MarioSprInteractRt. Returns Carry = contact.

MarioSprInteractRt.name: Mario-sprite interaction rate check
summary: Runs ProcessInteract every frame if tweaker $167A bit 5 is set, else only every other frame and when on screen.

ReturnNoContact.name: Return: no contact
summary: Carry clear, return.

ProcessInteract.name: Test Mario against sprite
summary: Checks distance, animation, layer and hitbox overlap. Returns Carry = 1 on contact.
If tweaker $167A bit 7 is clear, continues into DefaultInteractR.

DefaultInteractR.name: Default Mario interaction: star kill
summary: If Mario has star power and the sprite is not immune ($167A bit 1): kill the sprite with a chain score and sound, flung away from Mario.
Otherwise branches to $01A87E (next chunk).
